use_case: AI-enabled device software function for US-2 ultrasound: estimates left ventricular ejection fraction from cardiac clips and flags low-quality views
business_owner: Medical Devices chief medical officer (clinical); VP Engineering (technical)
vendor_or_model: In-house deep learning model (locked), running on the US-2 device
data_categories: Training: 48,000 de-identified cardiac ultrasound clips from 11 partner sites with expert labels. Production: images processed on the device under hospital control; results stored in the hospital's systems
consequential_decision_category: Health care; Safety/CI (device function affecting patient care)
human_in_the_loop: Clinician reviews every estimate and the images; the estimate is labeled adjunctive; the tool never records a diagnosis on its own
applicable_laws: FD&C Act device requirements and 21 CFR 820.10(c) design controls; FD&C Act 524B (cyber device; N31-33-R05); FDA draft guidance on AI-enabled device software functions (January 2025, nonbinding draft); FDA PCCP guidance for AI-enabled device software functions (December 2024, nonbinding); 45 CFR 92.210 duties of hospital customers; FTC Act Section 5 (performance claims); Colorado SB26-189 carve-out for FDA-regulated devices (counsel confirming)
status: In development; design freeze 2027-01-31; marketing submission planned 2027 Q2

use_case: Predictive maintenance for fielded IX-4 pumps and PM-7 monitors from DCC telemetry (battery and mechanism wear)
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted model in the DCC
data_categories: Device telemetry (no patient identifiers used as features); service history
consequential_decision_category: None directly; re-tier to Safety/CI if it ever acts on devices
human_in_the_loop: Biomedical engineers and field service decide every service action; the model only prioritizes work orders
applicable_laws: 21 CFR 820 servicing records (820.35(b)); HIPAA (DCC business associate; telemetry minimized); hospital contracts

use_case: Enterprise generative AI coding assistant for device firmware, DCC, and pipeline code
vendor_or_model: Enterprise coding assistant (vendor SaaS) under a contract with no training on company data
data_categories: Source code and design comments (Confidential); no PHI, signing material, or embargoed vulnerability details
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review, test, and merge every suggestion through normal code review with a second reviewer; not used for cryptographic, signing, or key-handling code
applicable_laws: FD&C Act 524B(b)(2) and 21 CFR 820.10(c) (secure development of device software); trade secret protection; open-source license obligations; POL-05 4.8

human_in_the_loop: Planners review and override forecasts; critical items have manual floors

use_case: Customer service chatbot on the ordering portal (order status, returns, product availability)
